subject: c12-pe
note: Unit marks as printed in the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus (* = concept-based questions). The printed figures do not add up to the stated theory total of 70, so use them as a guide only. Practical is 30 marks.
mistakes: Fixtures: check the count first. A knock-out needs n - 1 matches and a single league needs n(n - 1)/2.
Byes are needed only when the number of teams is not a power of 2. Byes = next power of 2 minus the number of teams.
For each asana, write the procedure, the benefits and the contraindications separately. Do not skip the contraindications.
Harvard Step Test: use the exercise time in seconds and the pulse count taken 1 to 1.5 minutes after exercise.
Keep the record file complete and neat: the record file and viva together carry 10 of the 30 practical marks.
order: Start with Unit 8, Biomechanics (10 marks): Newton's laws, levers, friction, projectile.
Then Units 4, 6 and 7, which are about 8 marks each.
Then Units 2, 3, 5 and 9, which are about 7 marks each.
Do practical and record file work alongside the theory.
